label: Longitudinal trajectories of hematological indices and serum metalloproteinases-2 and 9 over 1 year after moderate and severe COVID-19.
summary: The long-term clinical burden of Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) remains substantial, yet one-year cohort evidence linking blood-based biomarkers to persistent sequelae is limited. We conducted a longitudinal study in adults aged 18-80 years who were classified as moderate or severe COVID-19 or non-COVID-19 controls.
